headline: Front Ledger Puts Six Sectors Under Watch
war_summary: Since the last edition, the sharpest movement remains in the contested belt, though the hour-by-hour picture has shifted. Deadlands reports four ownership events in the latest two hours and 19 over 24, with two Warden-held bases against nine Colonial-held; Callahan’s Passage shows no fresh event in two hours but a remarkable surge in casualties and enlistments, keeping its 10-base Warden line under scrutiny. Stlican Shelf has gone quiet in the latest two-hour window after five events in six hours and 29 in the day, while its nine bases remain split three Warden and six Colonial. Weathered Expanse likewise records no turnover in six hours, but still lists 24 events over the day and a six-to-three Warden-Colonial division. Stonecradle’s ledger is still, for the moment, without a two-hour change, yet casualties, enlistments, and recent activity have accelerated sharply around its eight-to-one Warden majority. Marban Hollow is the freshest small front, with two events in two hours and one neutral base. Elsewhere, most sectors report no recent ownership movement.
